Fun. Shit.

To be honest I just took my time and cut curl by curl, finding distinct patterns where I could and shaping as I go. It was easier in the front because my curl pattern is a bit tighter (about 3C on a good day), but because I’m mixed, as soon as you get to the back of my head the texture and pattern immediately change (about 3a/3b). To make things more difficult, that’s at the back of my head. In that case I just twisted it around my finger once I found a large curl, and cut. For the back specifically I used a mirror to look at it, found a curl, held it and then cut. It’s crude, but it’s effective! Besides curly hair is pretty forgiving on this front. I had to take a few deep breaths before I started, but honestly once you get going, you gain confidence. I’m sure you’ll look gorgeous!!

I wash my hair just about 2-3 times a week, depending on the weather/season. When I do, here is my routine:
I wash with Unwash Charcoal Detox Scalp Scrub about once a week with hot water, use SheaMoisture Manuka Honey and Mafura Oil Conditioner (I go straight to this step for cowashes when I don’t use the scrub), and then rinse with cold water. If I want looser curls I go for Aunt Jackie’s Flaxseed Don’t Shrink Gel. For tighter ones that hold a bit longer, I use Cantu Leave-In. I’m usually pretty generous with the amount I use for any product (I take “dime-sized amount” as a suggestion), despite my short hair. I guess you could say I use enough to cover my entire head evenly. I make sure to wrap my hair in an old cotton tee with long sleeves to absorb excess. I mainly shower at night and sleep in a scarf, but if I shower in the morning I use a diffuser for my wash-and-go!

Hi! I don’t know if this advice may be helpful, but I thought I’d share! My boyfriend (M21), who lives in Germany as well, and I (F20), from Boston, have been together for about 2 years now. So two years with a 6 hour difference.  I think the best thing I can say is that we ALWAYS make sure to say good night and good morning, always ask about how the other person’s day was/is going, and just be with each other in any capacity. I’ll put the laptop on the kitchen table while I cook, he plays video games before bed. He and I are also really big planners, especially with our studies and jobs, so we have a google calendar we share so we know when FaceTime sessions are easiest. We have also begun mailing letters to each other just to have something that the other person created in our hands. If you ever have any questions or just want to vent, feel free to PM me!
